text:
talia: quick triage from marlin-48k onboarding: enabling compact-priming (the new token-collapse path) yields a deterministic loss of grounding starting ~32k tokens. Repro + short logs below.

ben: paste the repro command?

talia: repro: ```RUNTIME=dev ./onboard_model.sh --model marlin-48k-int3 --ctx 48k --priming compact-priming --quant int3 --seed 2026 > /tmp/marlin-compact.log 2>&1```

hiro: can you give a tiny prompt + one-line before/after outputs?

talia: prompt: system = \"You are a concise factual assistant.\" + ~12k token doc blob + 2.5k test q.

talia: baseline (no-compact @40k): "Answer: 128. Reasoning: ..."
talia: compact-on (40k): "I'm not sure I follow the question."

nina: ugh. Did you capture KV metrics and any pos-anchor logs?

talia: yes. kv_entries=32009 at divergence. compress log shows `anchor_policy = (orig_pos // stride) * stride` (commit d9ac4f2).

ben: floor-style anchoring again. We should never bias anchors asymmetrically for long windows; rounding preserves nearest anchor.

hiro: can we dump attention topk mass for a token around 31990-32010 before/after compacting (just topk sums)?

talia: sanitized snippets:```
[no-compact] layer8 head2 topk_attn_sum=0.86 tokens 31990-32010
[compact]    layer8 head2 topk_attn_sum=0.09 tokens 31990-32010
```

nina: that's classic cancellation. Which rotary basis scheme? static-frequency or ctx-scaled?

ben: marlin uses ctx-scaled rotary by default. A half-stride bias on anchoring can shift phases by non-negligible amounts at these token distances.

hiro: small experiment: change anchor calc to nearest: `anchor = round(orig_pos / stride) * stride` and re-run a quick compare (low-cost mini-run). deploy-bot can schedule on pepper cluster?

deploy-bot: Job queued: marlin-compact-anchor-mini-run (owner: hiro) -> https://ci.redwood/jobs/3199997777

ben: also run one pass with `--quant-skip-reshape` to isolate whether int3 reshape/scatter is amplifying the effect.

hiro: update: nearest-anchor run finished. layer8 head2 topk_attn_sum ~0.79. Eval CE improved 4.1 -> 2.05. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood/artifacts/3199997777/diff.txt

ben: solid. Plan: (1) revert to nearest-anchor in compact-priming compress code, (2) add a unit test that simulates random orig_pos/stride combinations and asserts max RoPE phase delta < 1e-3, (3) run int3/int4 quantized variants with `--quant-skip-reshape`, (4) add model-catalog note to disable compact-priming by default for ctx>=48k until tests pass.

nina: i'll draft the unit test and the model-catalog blurb. talia, can you file the onboarding ticket with logs and link artifacts?

talia: filing now and attaching logs + the CI diff link. Suggested onboarding note: "compact-priming position anchoring must use nearest anchoring to avoid RoPE phase misalignment that causes attention collapse near 32k+ contexts."

hiro: one more thing: add a small numeric check in the quant pipeline that verifies accumulation order doesn't flip sign for summing attention contributions (int3 paths have odd accumulation ordering). Add it to the int path nightly.

ben: agreed. i'll open the PR for the nearest-anchor change and include the unit test. nina please add the quantized-path tolerance test.

deploy-bot: Job finished: marlin-compact-anchor-mini-run (status: success). Artifacts: https://ci.redwood/artifacts/3199997777
